about: Real output of the web's Smart View functions for fixed input. `fn` names the function in chat-app/features/smartView/. See docs/MOBILE_SMART_VIEW.md section 5.

inferType.label: ten digits is not an amount
the word 'contact' anywhere in the name
a list written as JSON text
text with a number-like first character

filters.label: search: accents are NOT folded (é differs from e)
search: matches the same column text the person sees (a date is its stored text)
in with an empty list is inactive (ignored, not 'match nothing')
equals with an empty value is inactive
number eq (text numbers are read: 1,200 and 45%)
number ne (blank rows do NOT match)
number between with both ends empty is inactive
date on (by local day; d/m/yyyy is day first)
date between is inclusive by day
a condition on a column that does not exist matches nothing for text ops

sort.label: text asc: case-insensitive, numeric-aware ('Item 2' < 'Item 9' < 'Item 10'), blanks last
number asc: '1,200' and '45%' read as numbers, blank last, ties keep original order
number desc: ties STILL keep original order (not reversed)
date asc (mixed ISO and d/m/yyyy), blank last
bool column sorts as lower-cased text of the stored value

group.label: one level: groups in order of first appearance (not sorted), blank = (empty), sum of the measure
a closed group shows no rows (closed is keyed by path, not saved in a view)
group by a date column: the key is the stored text, not the formatted date

datePresetsSunday.nowLocal: 2026-11-22 (Sunday: the week is Monday to Sunday)

structureCells.note: input = the real ai.enterprise entry and the real submissions.list rows (docs/examples/smartview/04-*.json and 10-*.json); output = what each cell holds BEFORE formatCell
